title: Making a Large Island
inputFormat: Implement largestIsland(grid). Receive a nonempty n × n matrix containing only numeric 0 and 1. You may modify the matrix while computing the answer.
outputFormat: Return the largest possible island area (number of cells) after changing at most one 0 to 1.
